_comment: SHUFFLE_DECK is not an effect type. It sat inside a lazily-compiled branch, so it did not fail at load -- it raised ValueError the moment the search resolved. SEARCH_DECK already shuffles at the end of every search, so the node was redundant as well as fatal. Its search then named target 'single' (not a card), put the blood-debt test in effect-level 'conditions' -- which the loader turns into a gate on the SOURCE card, asking whether Shadow of Blasmophet itself has blood debt -- and expressed 'banish it' as a nested 'effects' list SEARCH_DECK does not read. So it searched for any card and put it in HAND. Now a keyword filter with action=banish.
